notes.title: Buried Stars Streaming Policy
notes.content:
In principle, Buried Stars allows the publication of videos and screenshots captured in the game.
However, the following policy restrictions have been put in place to allow more people to enjoy playing Buried Stars, so please abide by them.

[h2]1. Restrictions on specific sections in-game[/h2]
After reaching a specific point in the latter half of the main route of Buried Stars, the information on the following screen will be displayed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310500/fd246af5b4c69ff0a1e5dd1e7b240bf5125b3783.jpg[/img]

Up until this information is displayed, the publication of in-game videos and screenshots are permitted without restriction.
After this information is displayed, the following restrictions apply for the remainder of the game, including the ending credits and until the player returns to the Title Menu (this area will be referred to as the "Restricted Section").

[h3]Videos[/h3]
Videos in the restricted section can only be transmitted in the form of live broadcasts.
Additionally, each of the following actions is prohibited regarding saving videos in the restricted section:

• Publishing original or edited footage of the restricted section on a streaming service in order to be viewed again
• Publishing original or edited footage of the restricted section on YouTube or similar video-sharing platforms
• Generating profits during the live broadcast of the restricted section

[h3]Screenshots[/h3]
Screenshots of the restricted sections are allowed to be published freely under the premise that maximum discretion is taken to prevent ruining the game for others by adding spoiler warnings, etc.
That being said, each of the following actions is prohibited regarding relevant screenshots:

• Arbitrarily altering screenshots related to the restricted section that distorts game content or provides actual information related to the restricted section of the game
• Generating profits through the publication of screenshots from the restricted section

[h2]2.General Restrictions[/h2]
Regardless of their relation to the restricted section, please refrain from publishing videos and screenshots in the following cases, as they will be considered unauthorized duplications of the game:

• Simply listing and posting gameplay videos without editing or publisher feedback
• Simply listing and posting gameplay screenshots without editing or publisher feedback

Regarding videos or screenshots of Buried Stars in violation of the above policies, copyright holder LINE Games may request the deletion of such videos and screenshots.

Additionally, if you have become interested in Buried Stars by watching videos or looking at screenshots, it would be greatly appreciated if you considered purchasing it.

We ask for your understanding and cooperation so that more people can enjoy Buried Stars.

notes.title: BURIED STARS Steam Global Release Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310500/64bc764f733dc64d9aed2f8c1f05fa7e33811fa4.png[/img]
[b]BURIED STARS is finally coming on-air on Steam![/b]
​
Buried Stars is a mystery adventure game presented by Studio Largo, launched on PlayStation® 4/VITA and NINTENDO SWITCH™ on July 30th, 2020.
At last, we are excited to tell you that it will be available for PC on Steam!
​
We will announce the release date very soon, and you can check our Steam store page and add it to your wishlist to get notified.​
​​
We are looking forward to meeting you all soon!
